answer: When k bonded identities equivocate in a correlated pattern, pairwise attribution creates C(k,2) liable links, so penalties scale as O(k²), rather than per key alone. Upon detection, an exponential capital-loss multiplier applies to the swarm’s escrows; asymmetric depreciation limits recovery. A prism-like audit distinguishes shared evidence from noise: many keys under one operator are no more independent than nectar-bearing branches of one orchard.
